title: Android overlay-window permission and settings API

freshness.volatility_notes: Recheck overlay permission and settings behavior when Android support or target SDK changes.

confidence.rationale: Official Android API reference for the overlay permission and TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY.

claims.claim: Apps targeting API 23 or later need the user to grant SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW before showing TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY windows; Settings.canDrawOverlays checks this authorization and ACTION_MANAGE_OVERLAY_PERMISSION opens the settings flow.
